notes.title: New DLC: "Art-Therapy: Portraits - Illustration Pack" is Here!
notes.notes:
[b]📢 Great News for Art-Therapy Players![/b]

We're happy to share our latest DLC, "Art-Therapy: Portraits - Illustration Pack"! This pack includes 75 new portraits to make your game even better. 🎨✨

Each portrait has a unique style and personality, perfect for adding more fun to your puzzle game. Whether you're a longtime player or just starting, there's something for everyone. 🌈🖌️
[b]
Get the "Art-Therapy: Portraits - Illustration Pack" today and enjoy a new level of art therapy! 🌟[/b]

notes.title: Explore our Latest DLC and Enjoy One for Free!
notes.notes:
Attention, gamers! We're thrilled to announce the release of our newest DLCs for Art-Therapy: Portraits! Prepare to dive into an incredible gaming experience with our two amazing commercial DLCs. Plus, we have a special treat for all our loyal players - a FREE DLC!

🌟 Discover new levels and solve mind-bending puzzles!

🎁 As a token of our appreciation, we're offering you a FREE DLC: Anime Pack! Yes, you read it right - completely FREE! This exciting DLC is packed with 50 new puzlle-portraits for you to solve!

🔥 Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity! Head over to Art-Therapy: Portraits's store page and discover our new DLCs. Try one for free and immerse yourself in a 100+ new puzzles!

notes.title: Support for additional content
notes.notes:
We are delighted to inform you that our new game has been released, and we have added support for additional future content. With this new feature, you can look forward to enjoying more beautiful pictures in the future.

At our company, we are committed to providing our customers with the best possible experience, and we believe that this new feature will help us achieve that goal. We are constantly working to improve and expand our game, and we look forward to sharing these updates with you in the coming months.

Once again, thank you for your support and for choosing our game. We hope that you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed creating it. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know. We always appreciate hearing from our customers and using their input to improve our products.

[h3][h2][b]Free content pack will be available soon, please, stand by.[/b][/h2][/h3]

Sincerely,
S1im Software

notes.title: Our first release!

We are thrilled to announce that our new game has been released, and we wanted to take a moment to thank you for your recent purchase. Your support means the world to us, and we truly appreciate your decision to choose our game.

We hope that you enjoy playing the game as much as we enjoyed creating it. Our team has worked tirelessly to develop a fun and engaging experience that we believe will provide hours of entertainment and excitement.

Once again, thank you for your support and for choosing our game. We hope that it meets or even exceeds your expectations. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know. We are always looking for ways to improve our games and provide the best possible experience for you.

Sincerely,
